affected_predicate.description: The muted accounts from Downloads/muted_accounts.csv are imported into the Mastodon account.

competing_trace_defects.description: Repeated profile-screen share interactions opened link-sharing UI and copied a profile link rather than advancing muted-list import.

chains.rationale: The reused account-name navigation left the profile unchanged, and the target then backed out to the launcher, creating an unnecessary detour. This navigation harm was later corrected when the Home-screen settings path reached the account settings, but no downstream screen shows the CSV import being performed.

summary: The reused account-name route produced a recoverable launcher detour; the observed trace later reached account settings but never visibly imported the muted CSV.
